Disclaimer: These are ancient Jewish writings attributed to biblical figures but composed during the intertestamental period (roughly 300 BC to 100 AD). While they influenced early Jewish and Christian thought, only 1 Enoch is directly quoted in Scripture (Jude 14–15). The Ethiopian Orthodox Church includes 1 Enoch in its canon; no other pseudepigraphal text holds that distinction. They are not considered canonical Scripture by most Christian traditions and are preserved here for historical study. See the Bible Canon section in Notes for more details.
